normalizationRules: ignore lines whose trimmed text starts with // or #

parityRules.defaultThreshold: max(10% of original normalized bytes, 1024 bytes)
parityRules.runtimeEmitCjsThreshold: max(1% of original normalized bytes, 1024 bytes), but CJS targets do not count as package source parity
parityRules.belowSeventyPercent: blocked unless evidence proves removed sections are generated, obsolete, dead, or root-only bootstrap code
